items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: he had me in a lawyer's office in California. Garden was his name, Lawyer Garden.

ctx.x: Yeah, but you really (inaudible) talking about it (inaudible) that's very funny because that must be the record company.

I can go -- I'm going to give you some more about this. I signed a contract with Hamp for two years, had my first contract at so much money. And on my second contract I signed for two years he had me in a lawyer's office in California. Garden was his name, Lawyer Garden.

And he brought both me and my wife over . He had a box of stockings for my wife. He had a fifth of something for me. I don't know what it was. And in this contract that he was to pay me so much a week, travel me first class and to bill me, to bill the band at the expiration of this contract and put -- finance me with $5,000.00, and he's going to have 50 percent of it.
